label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The cookie dialog had no clear decline button; only Accept All, Cookies Settings and Close. I used Close to dismiss it, and it was unclear whether that declined cookies.

Product cards on the home page are very long links that read price as Minimum Price and Maximum Price plus colour count, hard to scan by ear. Product list also disappeared and reappeared on the home page.

Product was out of stock but the home page card gave no sign of it; I only found out on the product page, where the Add to cart button is announced as notify me and the stock status is a loose text line before the heading.

After Add to cart the cart dialog opened showing subtotal 0.00 and disabled buttons with no announcement of loading, and the page behind only said Adding item to cart; I had to reread to learn the real state.

Checkout page first appeared nearly empty (only a heading and empty regions) with no loading message, so I could not tell if it was broken. Country defaulted to [name], not United States, and the phone field showed a +33 prefix.
